description: Duplicate an existing playlist into a new playlist, preserving track order. Creates the new playlist then adds tracks in batches of 100. Dry-run reports what would be created.

description.description: Description for the new playlist (defaults to source description)

dry_run.description: Preview only: validate inputs and describe exactly what would change without performing it

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

public.description: Public flag for the new playlist. Default: false

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

scan_cap.description: Maximum source rows to scan; bounded by SPOTIFY_MCP_FETCH_ALL_CAP

source_playlist_id.description: Source playlist ID, spotify:playlist: URI, or URL

name: copy_playlist
